look.about: Look applied to each figure in room.html (saved 2026-11-20). Colour: warmth/bright/contrast/sat, depth = back-row fade. Light: light = strength (0 = model-viewer default lighting), az = direction in degrees relative to the room camera (0 = from the camera, +90 = from the right), el = height in degrees, soft = spread in degrees. Style: outline in room pixels, ink = interior edge darkening, flat = posterise/smooth amount.
